title: observations
description: Long-format scalar observations. MIAPPE observed variable = trait + method + scale. One row per unit x time x variable.

time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (state the timezone assumption in the card if none is given).

event_id.description: Imaging round / session the value came from.

trait.description: What is measured (e.g. projected leaf area).

value.description: The value; null for missing (never a sentinel code).

qc.description: QC flags as a list or a ;-joined string.

source_table.description: Raw table (relative to the bundle root) the row came from.

source_row_key.description: Key of the raw row, for tracing back.
